name: KromiumWebResourceRequest
summary: Represents an outgoing web resource request that can be inspected and modified by a KromiumRequestInterceptor.
declaration:
data class KromiumWebResourceRequest(
    val url: String,
    val method: String,
    val headers: MutableMap<String, String>,
    val isNavigation: Boolean,
    val isDownload: Boolean,
    val resourceType: KromiumResourceType = KromiumResourceType.UNKNOWN,
    val requestInitiator: String? = null
)

constructors.signature: KromiumWebResourceRequest(url: String, method: String, headers: MutableMap<String, String>, isNavigation: Boolean, isDownload: Boolean, resourceType: KromiumResourceType = KromiumResourceType.UNKNOWN, requestInitiator: String? = null)
constructors.description: Constructs an outgoing web resource request model.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The destination URL of the request.

parameters.name: isNavigation
parameters.description: Whether this request represents a top-level or frame navigation.

parameters.name: isDownload
parameters.description: Whether this request initiates a file download.

parameters.name: resourceType
parameters.description: The resource type (e.g., SCRIPT, IMAGE, XHR).

parameters.name: requestInitiator
parameters.description: The origin URL that initiated this request, or null.
